On July 9, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Energy Recovery, Inc (the “Registrant”) appointed Mr. John Mitchell to its Board. With the appointment of Mr. Mitchell, the Registrant’s Board consists of six (6) directors. There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Mitchell and any other persons pursuant to which they were selected as a director. Mr. Mitchell will receive the same compensation (pro-rated for his actual service) and indemnification as the Registrant’s other non-employee directors. There are no family relationships between Mr. Mitchel and any of the officers or directors of the Registrant. There are no transactions between Mr. Mitchell and the Registrant that would be reportable under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. A copy of the press release announcing the appointment of Mr. Mitchell is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 hereto. Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.
